fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential network activity of Netreo RMM tool
fields.name: Potential Netreo RMM Tool Network Activity
fields.query: (event.category in ("dns","url","ip")) and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((url.address contains "charon.netreo.net" or url.address contains "activation.netreo.net" or url.address contains ".api.netreo.com" or url.address contains "netreo.com") or (event.dns.request contains "charon.netreo.net" or event.dns.request contains "activation.netreo.net" or event.dns.request contains ".api.netreo.com" or event.dns.request contains "netreo.com")))
